name: com.xengine.2d.psdimporter
description: Adobe Photoshop PSD/PSB importer: the layer tree with names, rects, groups, and pixels, a flattened composite texture, and one sprite per layer. Parser is the MIT Paint.NET PSD plugin, ported to pure C#. Official optional package: listed in Package Manager, not mounted until installed.

samples.description: A demo PSD, the .xui screen xui_from_psd generates from it, and the scaffolded controller with login logic — the whole pipeline in one folder.
